title: Language Models & Prompts
summary: This module provides core interfaces for interacting with various language models (LLMs) and chat models, along with functionalities for managing prompts, handling messages, generating embeddings, and integrating with third-party LLM providers.

nodes.label: LLM Interfaces
nodes.title: Language Model Interfaces
nodes.description: Defines the core interfaces for interacting with various language models (LLMs) and chat models, including abstract base classes and fake models for testing.

nodes.label: Message Handling
nodes.title: LLM Message Handling & Translation
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for handling and translating messages between various LLM provider formats and LangChain's internal content block representation.

nodes.label: Prompt Templates
nodes.title: Prompt Template Management
nodes.description: Offers a comprehensive set of classes and utilities for creating, managing, and formatting various types of prompt templates, including chat message and few-shot templates.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.title: Embedding Module Overview
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for generating text embeddings, including a factory for initializing various provider-specific embedding models and a caching mechanism.

nodes.label: Partner LLM Integrations
nodes.title: Partner LLM Integrations
nodes.description: Provides integrations for various third-party Large Language Models (LLMs) and chat models, handling API communication, message conversion, and streaming.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Language Model Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the abstract and concrete interfaces for interacting with various types of language models, providing a unified API for different providers.

groups.label: Message Handling
groups.title: LLM Message Processing
groups.description: Manages the conversion and manipulation of messages between different LLM provider formats and LangChain's internal representations.

groups.label: Prompt Templates
groups.title: Prompt Construction & Management
groups.description: Provides tools for creating, managing, and formatting prompts, including support for chat messages, few-shot examples, and structured outputs.

groups.label: Embeddings & Partner LLMs
groups.title: Embeddings and Third-Party LLM Integrations
groups.description: Handles the generation of text embeddings and integrates with a wide array of external language model providers, facilitating diverse model usage.
